## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include reproduction steps or a share code for generation changes, and before/after captures for visible changes. State any relevant checks that were not run, including hardware-dependent validation.

## Review notes

Mention affected interfaces, changed defaults or saved formats, and any remaining limitations. For cleanup, explain how you checked that removed code, scripts or assets have no maintained consumers.
